trans.sense: euphemism for the equivalent of the word "fuck"

examples.text: Oh, f-word, I've lost the keys.
The dialogue was littered with f-words.

raw_glosses: (euphemistic) The word fuck (or inflected forms like fucking) or fucker.
glosses: The word fuck (or inflected forms like fucking) or fucker.

examples.text: For quotations using this term, see Citations:f-word.
She has no luck with diets. Don't mention the f-word (by which I mean "fat").
Zack wouldn't say the F word. Not... forever. It was too soon to say that. He may be open to a serious relationship again, but he still needed to protect his heart in other ways.
